definitions.radial_profile: median native bathymetry in 5 m radial bins [0,5),...,[95,100)
definitions.relief_sign: sign(disk_median - annulus_median) in native source value convention
definitions.local_extremum: within 50 m of target: max native value when relief_sign positive, min native value when negative
definitions.half_relief_component: 8-connected threshold component containing local_extremum, evaluated in +/-100 m bathymetry window
definitions.component_axes: PCA projection max-min spans of component pixel-center coordinates in metres; aspect=max(span1,span2)/min(span1,span2)
definitions.boundary_touch: half-relief component touches +/-100m characterization window boundary
definitions.raster_line_check: at target row and column compare maximum absolute first-difference within +/-2 target pixels to distribution of maxima on 21 parallel profiles offsets -10..+10 pixels; record target percentile and median parallel-profile correlation
definitions.nodata_check: report valid fraction for each +/-50/100/250 m window
preliminary_morphology_rule: BROAD_GEOLOGIC_RELIEF if half-relief component touches +/-100m boundary
COMPACT_RELIEF otherwise when half-relief component is finite and coherent
POSSIBLE_RASTER_LINE_ARTEFACT only if target row or column first-difference statistic is >=99th percentile AND median parallel-profile gradient correlation >=0.90
